Dashboard.AccountDescription: Manage the selected account and the vaults used to discover SSH keys.
Dashboard.ConnectDescription: Sign in to the 1Password desktop app and connect your account to manage SSH keys.
Dashboard.SwitchAccountDescription: Connecting a different account clears the previous account’s vault scope, keys, approvals, and activity.
Dashboard.EnableSdk: After you continue, 1Password may ask you to authorize access to this account.
Dashboard.AccountsLoading: Looking for accounts on this device…
Dashboard.NoAccounts: The 1Password desktop app returned no signed-in accounts. Check that you’re signed in and CLI integration is enabled, then try again.
Dashboard.NoOtherAccount: Sign in to another account in the 1Password desktop app to switch to it here.
Dashboard.AccountsCliMissing: Install the official 1Password CLI 2 and enable CLI integration in the desktop app, then try again.
Dashboard.AccountsCliUntrusted: The 1Password CLI could not be verified. Install an official copy of 1Password CLI 2, then try again.
Dashboard.AccountsTimedOut: Looking for accounts timed out. Open the 1Password desktop app and try again.
Dashboard.AccountsBusy: 1Password is already looking for accounts. Try again shortly.
Dashboard.AccountsUnavailable: Could not read 1Password accounts. Open the desktop app, check CLI integration, and try again.
Dashboard.AccountsInvalidResponse: The 1Password CLI returned an invalid account list. Update the official CLI and try again.
Dashboard.LogoutDescription: This clears the vault scope, public index, loaded private keys, approvals, and activity for {0}.
Dashboard.DesktopAccessDescription: 1Password may ask you to authorize again when access is needed.
Dashboard.DesktopSessionExpired: 1Password access expired. Authorize the next request in 1Password.
Dashboard.VaultSaveFailed: Change not saved. The previous setting was restored. {0}
Dashboard.VaultUnavailable: This vault is no longer available. Refresh the vault list.
Dashboard.VaultScopeLimit: The maximum number of vault rules has been reached.
Dashboard.VaultScopeDescription: Changes take effect immediately. SSH key discovery only searches allowed vaults.
Dashboard.PartialVault: This vault has individual rules from an earlier configuration. Changing this checkbox replaces those rules for the vault.
Dashboard.NoVaults: Reload vaults to list the vaults available to this account.
Dashboard.ChooseVaults: Allow at least one vault, then open SSH Keys to discover keys.
Dashboard.DiscoverAfterVaultChange: Public keys from newly allowed vaults appear after your next manual discovery.
Dashboard.SettingsDescription: Manage startup, SSH integration, cache policies, and display preferences. Changes take effect immediately.
Dashboard.StartWithWindowsDescription: Start opssh in the system tray after you sign in.
Dashboard.WaitForPasswordDescription: Wait for the 1Password desktop app before requesting account access at opssh startup.
Dashboard.StartupNoAccount: You’ll be prompted to choose an account when 1Password starts.
Dashboard.StartupSaveFailed: Could not save the startup setting.
Dashboard.StartupConflict: Another entry uses the opssh startup name.
Dashboard.DefaultAgent: Use as the system default SSH agent
Dashboard.DefaultAgentDescription: Windows SSH clients that use the default agent will connect to opssh.
Dashboard.EnableDefaultTitle: Use opssh as the system default SSH agent?
Dashboard.EnableDefaultDescription: opssh will stop and disable the Windows OpenSSH agent service and listen on the default OpenSSH pipe. Windows may ask for administrator approval.
Dashboard.DisableDefaultDescription: opssh will return to its dedicated pipe. The Windows OpenSSH agent service will start and be set to automatic. Windows may ask for administrator approval.
Dashboard.DefaultRecovery: Windows could not finish the SSH agent change. Check the Windows OpenSSH agent service before trying again.
Dashboard.DefaultChangeFailed: Could not change the system default SSH agent.
Dashboard.PowerShellDescription: Run this command in the current PowerShell session to point it to the opssh listener.
Dashboard.CommandCopyFailed: Could not copy the command. Select the command and press Ctrl+C.
Dashboard.KeyCacheOffHint: Release the private key when the current request finishes.
Dashboard.CacheFixedHint: Time starts when the cache entry is created.
Dashboard.CacheIdleHint: Clear after the specified time without use.
Dashboard.KeyCacheExitHint: Clear when opssh exits. You can also clear it manually.
Dashboard.ApprovalCacheExitHint: Keep while the approved process is active. Revoke at any time, or exit opssh to clear.
Dashboard.AboutDescription: Sign with SSH keys stored in 1Password from your Windows SSH client.
Dashboard.AutoCheckUpdates: Automatically check for updates at startup
Dashboard.GitHubDescription: View the source code and releases.
